name: JW Marriott Savannah Plant Riverside District
insider_take: This stunning riverfront property occupies a beautifully restored 1912 power plant, where industrial heritage meets modern luxury in Savannah's most dynamic entertainment district.
whats_special: The hotel's unique location in a former electric power plant creates an atmospheric blend of exposed brick, soaring ceilings, and contemporary design. You're steps away from live music venues, craft breweries, and waterfront dining, all while enjoying direct access to the Savannah River. The Plant Riverside District itself is a $200 million mixed-use development that's transformed this historic area into the city's premier entertainment destination.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room to watch the massive cargo ships navigate the Savannah River - it's one of the busiest ports on the East Coast and provides incredible views day and night.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary water taxi across the river to explore Hutchinson Island, or stroll the adjacent River Street's cobblestones for shopping and dining. The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of Forsyth Park's famous fountain and the entire Historic District's 24 squares - no car needed to experience Savannah's legendary charm.
pros: Prime Savannah River waterfront location with stunning views
Historic Plant Riverside District setting with unique industrial charm
Luxury JW Marriott amenities and service standards
Walking distance to Savannah's Historic District attractions
cons: Popular venue may experience high occupancy during peak seasons
